title: Case: Tracking says delivered but the recipient has no parcel
context: The system displays delivery, but the verified recipient reports no receipt. Registration of an investigation is the task outcome, not a finding of loss or fraud.
initial_request: No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.

events.body: DL-1343 displays delivered at 08:10 UTC today. We have not reviewed the handover record or route stop. Only the shipment and recipient account match are verified.
No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.
Please open a delivery investigation for DL-1343: verified recipient reports no receipt despite the 08:10 delivered scan. Review the handover and route records; do not assume a loss decision.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Delivery investigations, Marrowby Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
The recipient report and scan conflict, but neither establishes fraud, confirmed loss or reimbursement.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-024: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
